data.title: Home headline and Travel card answered my questions plainly

data.detail: I can say what they do and where (health, housing, youth and cultural exchange in Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic and the US), and I found a way to take part without money (Travel: join a scheduled trip or bring a group). No email or account was asked for. The auto-rotating story strip on the home page cost me most of my patience before my taps landed.
